name: What kind of preparation is needed before cabinet installers arrive?
description: Clear the work area of personal items and appliances. If old cabinets are already removed, ensure the space is empty and clean. Protect floors and countertops.

mainEntity.name: What kind of preparation is needed before cabinet installers arrive?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before cabinet installers arrive, it's beneficial to clear the work area of any personal items, furniture, and appliances to provide clear access. If old cabinets are being removed by another party, ensure the space is empty and clean. Protecting floors and countertops is also recommended. We will provide a detailed checklist of preparation steps during our planning phase to ensure a smooth installation.
